quarantined_leads.lead: The House Committee on Ethics published a statement and reports recommending that the House hold Michael Joseph and Hector Roos in contempt for failing to comply with subpoenas in the former Representative Sheila Cherfilus-McCormick matter.
quarantined_leads.source_title: Statement of the Chairman and Ranking Member of the Committee on Ethics Regarding House Report 119-693 and House Report 119-694
quarantined_leads.subject_response: The official statement says Michael Joseph submitted a response to the Clerk of the House on June 18, 2026; no response from Hector Roos was located in the reviewed materials.
quarantined_leads.reason: The official publication is in the lookback, but the contempt reports were adopted on June 10 and concern a city mayor and a former campaign aide rather than a covered congressional member or senior congressional staffer. No explicit Republican, conservative, Trump-administration, or qualifying affiliated-organizational role was documented for either named subject. The recommendation is therefore not emitted as an A03 event.

quarantined_leads.lead: A local Virginia report said Representative John McGuire responded to a Democratic opponent's accusation of insider trading and denied that he trades stocks.
quarantined_leads.source_title: John McGuire fights back at insider trading jab: 'I don't even do trades'
quarantined_leads.subject_response: McGuire said he would not debate until opponent Tom Perriello apologized for accusing him of insider trading and said, 'I don't even do trades.'
quarantined_leads.reason: The current report is a single local account of a partisan accusation and subject denial. No official ethics complaint, OCC referral, court filing, law-enforcement action, or independent corroboration establishing misconduct was located in the lookback. The allegation is quarantined under the single-source and partisan-accusation rules.

quarantined_leads.lead: A nonofficial page dated August 28 restated an earlier OCC referral concerning Representative Nancy Mace and described the House Ethics review as continuing.
quarantined_leads.source_title: House Ethics Committee Investigation of Rep. Nancy Mace (OCC Review 25-5681)
quarantined_leads.subject_response: The page did not report a new statement from Representative Mace in the lookback.
quarantined_leads.reason: The page is not an official government or reputable news source and identifies the underlying OCC referral as dated December 1, 2025, with the official OCC listing dated March 2, 2026. It does not document a new in-window action, so it is not emitted as an event.
